orientation: row-major; row0=north; col0=west; endpoints include bbox boundaries
verticalDatum: Source-native SRTM/GMTED composite; approximately EGM96 orthometric heights. Per-pixel source/datum not independently verified; no datum conversion applied.
resampling: Bilinear interpolation of Terrarium raster pixel centres; grid values rounded to0.001 m for serialization, not measurement accuracy.
attribution: Terrain: Mapzen/Tilezen; SRTM and GMTED2010 data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey. Accessed via AWS Open Data Terrain Tiles.
license: Underlying SRTM and GMTED2010 described as public-domain datasets by provider; retain USGS/Mapzen attribution. See source-specific terms, not a blanket license for unrelated terrain regions.
limitations: 2017 terrain-tile products based on older source surveys; not current LiDAR, cadastral or building-free site survey.
SRTM urban/vegetation and source-resampling artifacts may remain. Do not use for engineering or navigation.
No water flattening, synthetic hill, height normalization or landmark ground-altitude override applied.
Bounded bbox only. Sampler clamps outside requests to edge for padded-world continuity; this extrapolation is a game approximation, not source coverage.
